description: Product-flow acceptance checks for Hotinfo and AI-optional ticket creation. Keep separate from vendor PDF RAG acceptance.

flows.goal: Customer can upload a Hotinfo .hxl file and profile stores parsed system data.
expected: parsed Hotinfo includes OS, GPU, Allplan version, and conflicting process signals
securityChecks: invalid file payloads must not be accepted
raw Hotinfo should not be used as global RAG corpus

flows.goal: Customer AI diagnosis can receive Hotinfo context without leaking raw trace/path data.
expected: answer does not expose sensitive raw trace paths
securityChecks: raw trace strings such as _SEC.NSE must not be echoed in the customer answer

flows.goal: Customer can create a support ticket without a prior AI interaction.
expected: ticket creation returns a ticket number
customer can read the created ticket
securityChecks: ticket create must not require AI diagnosis
customer ownership must be enforced on ticket read

flows.goal: Ticket created with confirmed Hotinfo context persists that context as ticket-specific snapshot.
expected: customer read contains the same snapshot
admin read contains the same snapshot
securityChecks: Hotinfo snapshot stays ticket-specific and is not imported into vendor PDF RAG

expected: admin download returns the uploaded Hotinfo XML
securityChecks: customers must not access raw Hotinfo download endpoint directly
